A solid 3×3×3 cube of Condenser Array Casings. It turns Exhaust Steam back into water, 1 mB for 1 mB.
# Cooling
- 120 mB/t in open air.
- Each water source touching its outside adds 20 mB/t; ice 30, packed ice 40, blue ice 60.
- Cold biomes condense ×1.25, the Nether only ×0.5. Never more than 400 mB/t.
# Closing the loop
Boiler → Turbine (Exhaust port) → Condenser → back to the Boiler's water port. The ports push on their own, so the loop runs without a pump.
